title: WeddingRsvpSettings
description: A wedding's RSVP settings (issue #30): whether households may still answer on their RSVP page. A record of its own (keyed by wedding_id), so an older build's edit of the wedding can never drop it. No record means open.

tenant_id.description: The owning tenant. Compared to the context's tenant only; never selects the partition.

closed.description: True once the planner closes RSVPs: the page then shows the answers without letting anyone change them.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the last change, from the injected clock.
